description: This source file implements the MediaPlayerManager class, which manages media player clients, including attaching, detaching, and controlling media playback instances, utilizing GStreamer objects and client backends.

classes.name: MediaPlayerManager
classes.description: Class responsible for managing media player clients, including creation, control, and cleanup of media playback sessions.

methods.name: attachMediaPlayerClient
methods.description: Attaches a media player client to a specified GstObject parent, creating a new client if necessary.

methods.name: getMediaPlayerClient
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the current media player client.

methods.name: hasControl
methods.description: Checks if the manager currently has control over the media player client.

methods.name: releaseMediaPlayerClient
methods.description: Releases the current media player client, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: acquireControl
methods.description: Attempts to acquire control over a media player client.

methods.name: createMediaPlayerClient
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new media player client associated with a GstObject parent.
